title: Decorate the tree 2.0
targetLabel: The tree: a mega tree, a matrix or any model with a grid
intro: Visitors decorate a tree of the show anywhere they like: on the phone they pick a decoration (bauble, candy cane, star, bell, present, snowflake, heart), its colour, effects and size, and drag it onto a drawing of the tree; while they drag, it blinks on the real tree where they hold it. Then one button hangs it (or several at once). The decorations are placed by where the tree's pixels really are in the layout, so on a 360° mega tree they go all the way round. The colours are corrected for LEDs (gamma, balance; see the colour test). When the tree is full: a party, then it starts again. Pick the tree, then Save.
